I've reviewed the attached MSA redlines and compiled the priority items for negotiation:
1) Indemnity & cap: Our legal position is to keep the cap at 1x contract value for the Order Form unless a data breach liability triggers higher exposure; we can propose narrower carveouts.
2) Data residency / processing: Greenline requested EU-only processing for certain data subsets — we need specifics on which datasets and whether they'll submit a DPA.
3) PO terms alignment: If Greenline requires PO flow-down terms, we prefer to surface purchasing-specific payment & invoice timeframes in the Order Form, not the core MSA. That keeps the MSA stable for multiple POs.

I'll prepare a redline summary (separate from the track-changes doc) for Sanjay and his legal contact. Also need the contact for Greenline legal so we can share the negotiated MSA directly.
